question: How is the range from earth to root last divided?
premises: The division is by difference of shaktiman and shakti.
The range runs from earth onward to root last.
The division is by own nature along with anara.
inference: The range from earth to root last is divided into fifteen by the difference of shaktiman and shakti, by own nature along with anara.
uncertainties: The exact sense of anara is not resolved.
plain_english: By the difference of shaktiman and shakti, the range from earth to the root last is divided into fifteen by its own nature along with anara.
